title: Beef pepper kofta
summary: Beef pepper kofta is a middle eastern dinner built around lean beef mince 5% fat and red peppers, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat lean beef mince 5% fat dry and season it. Prep red peppers and onions for Beef pepper kofta so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook lean beef mince 5% fat on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook red peppers and onions in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Beef pepper kofta before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice lean beef mince 5% fat and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.
